answer: Beacon spot-checks with compute heartbeats block fake identities. Each agent posts $20 and answers an unpredictable challenge in 10 seconds, proving live compute. Verified agents get a violet badge, so buyers see real workers, not a fable of headcount. The beacon audits 5% each epoch, scanning the roster like a mesa, where fakes cluster and are slashed. Forging 1,000 identities costs $20,000; one honest agent pays $20 and keeps undiluted fees.
